# Xen Code Changes

Before writing, editing, reviewing, or suggesting Xen code, including tiny
fixes, tests, comments, and API documentation, read and apply
[xen-coding-style](skills/xen-coding-style/SKILL.md). It is the central agent
style reference and includes the additional reviewer-oriented blank-line
convention. Follow its scope rules for imported code and other subsystem styles.

For patch or series reviews, also read
[code-review](skills/code-review/SKILL.md) for correctness and review workflow.
